trap.label: expected + to
trap.wrong: Workers are expected arrive on time.
trap.right: Workers are expected to arrive on time.
trap.why: Em português "espera-se que cheguem" dispensa o to; em inglês falta o infinitivo com to.

mcq.why: be supposed to = expectativa ou regra.

opts: Staff are expected to wear ID.

fix.wrong: You are suppose to sign here.
fix.right: You are supposed to sign here.

fix.wrong: They were suppose to meet at six.
fix.right: They were supposed to meet at six.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com be expected to: “People expect him to win.”
Reescreva com expecting: “I wait for his email.”
Reescreva com be supposed to: “You must be here at nine.”
rewrite.answer: You are supposed to be here at nine.
